summary: Frontend-only verification of founder-section overlap fix and facts copy change. Automated bounding-box overlap detection (all leaf text/img nodes inside founder-section and story-section, after scrolling to trigger Reveal animations) found ZERO overlaps at 390x844, 768x1024, 1366x900 and 1920x1080. Screenshots confirm on mobile/tablet the facts list now sits fully above the 'MEET YOUR COACH' eyebrow / 'MEET ALYSHA LEE.' headline with clear spacing; desktop shows 2-column layout with no overlap. Story section clean on mobile and desktop. Facts list shows 'Former Division I swimmer at Arizona State, coached by Bob Bowman and Michael Phelps'; 'Olympic' appears nowhere in page text or frontend source. Nav regression: nav-link-founder (desktop) and mobile-link-founder (mobile menu) both scroll founder-section to top=69px (just below the fixed header). No deprecated Expo packages in referenced files.

issues: Cosmetic: GoldRule sets alignSelf:'flex-start' (src/ui.tsx:82), which overrides the row's alignItems:'center' in Founder.tsx:69, so the 16px gold dash is pinned to the top edge of each fact row (~8px above the text's vertical center, more noticeable on the 2-line first fact on mobile). Pass style={{ alignSelf: 'center' }} to GoldRule in the FACTS map if centered dashes are desired.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: vertically center the gold dash beside each fact in the founder facts list (Founder.tsx:70 -> <GoldRule width={16} style={{ alignSelf: 'center' }} />).
critical_code_review_comments: Founder.tsx: sticky/top offset removed from both MeetAlysha and Story columns; layout now uses plain flex column on narrow and row on wide - correct fix for the root cause.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Founder overlap bug verified fixed via JS bounding-box overlap check across 4 viewports. Sticky mobile 'JOIN THE WAITLIST' bottom bar overlays content by design.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: desktop sticky top offset (100px) was applied on mobile column layout, shifting photo+facts down into the eyebrow/headline. Fix removed the offset; verified no overlap.
